summary: Start isolated seats on Ubuntu 22.04 and other older systemd user managers.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Systemd 236–253 scopes preserve literal argv without the unsupported expansion option. Systemd 254+ retains --expand-environment=no. Both paths require a reachable user manager and disable password prompts.

downtime.detail: Restart the daemon to select the updated isolation capability; interruption duration has not been measured.

manual.detail: No argument escaping or manual configuration is required for older supported user managers.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes; rollback restores the previous launcher behavior.
